items.source: NOTE: This DataSource proxy needs to return wrapped Connections (which implement the ConnectionProxy interface) in order to handle lazy fetching of an actual JDBC Connection. Use Wrapper.unwrap(Class) to retrieve the native JDBC Connection.
items.translation: 注意：此 DataSource 代理需要返回包装后的连接（实现ConnectionProxy接口），以便处理实际 JDBC 连接的懒加载。请使用Wrapper.unwrap(Class)获取原生 JDBC 连接。

items.source: If you configure both a LazyConnectionDataSourceProxy and a TransactionAwareDataSourceProxy, make sure that the latter is the outermost DataSource. In such a scenario, data access code will talk to the transaction-aware DataSource, which will in turn work with the LazyConnectionDataSourceProxy. As of 6.1.2, LazyConnectionDataSourceProxy will initialize its default connection characteristics on first Connection access; to enforce this on startup, call checkDefaultConnectionProperties().
items.translation: 如果您同时配置了 LazyConnectionDataSourceProxy 和 TransactionAwareDataSourceProxy，请确保后者是最外层的 DataSource。 在这种情况下，数据访问代码将与事务感知的 DataSource 通信，而该 DataSource 进而与 LazyConnectionDataSourceProxy 协作。自 6.1.2 版本起，LazyConnectionDataSourceProxy 会在首次访问 Connection 时初始化其默认连接特性；若要强制在启动时执行此操作，请调用 checkDefaultConnectionProperties()。

items.source: This property accepts the int constant value (for example, 8) as defined in the Connection interface; it is mainly intended for programmatic use. Consider using the "defaultTransactionIsolationName" property for setting the value by name (for example, "TRANSACTION_SERIALIZABLE").
items.translation: 此属性接受 `int` 常量值（例如，8），该值定义在Connection接口中；它主要用于编程用途。建议使用"defaultTransactionIsolationName"属性通过名称设置值（例如，"TRANSACTION_SERIALIZABLE"）。

items.source: This DataSource proxy allows to avoid fetching JDBC Connections from a pool unless actually necessary. JDBC transaction control can happen without fetching a Connection from the pool or communicating with the database; this will be done lazily on first creation of a JDBC Statement. As a bonus, this allows for taking the transaction-synchronized read-only flag and/or isolation level into account in a routing DataSource (for example, IsolationLevelDataSourceRouter).
items.translation: 此 DataSource 代理允许仅在必要时才从池中获取 JDBC 连接。JDBC 事务控制可以在不获取池中的连接或不与数据库通信的情况下进行；这将在首次创建 JDBC Statement 时懒加载执行。此外，这还允许在路由 DataSource（例如，IsolationLevelDataSourceRouter）中考虑事务同步的只读标志和/或隔离级别。

items.source: If available, a Connection from such a read-only DataSource will be lazily obtained within a Spring-managed transaction that has been marked as read-only. The Connection.setReadOnly(boolean) flag will be left untouched, expecting it to be pre-configured as a default on the read-only DataSource, avoiding the overhead of switching it at the beginning and end of every transaction. Also, the default auto-commit and isolation level settings are expected to match the default connection properties of the primary target DataSource.
items.translation: 如果可用，来自此类只读数据源的连接将在已标记为只读的 Spring 管理事务中懒加载获取。Connection.setReadOnly(boolean) 标志将保持原样，预期它已在只读数据源上作为默认配置预先设置，从而避免在每个事务的开始和结束时切换该标志的开销。此外，默认的自动提交和隔离级别设置应与主目标数据源的默认连接属性相匹配。

items.source:
Lazy fetching of physical JDBC Connections is particularly beneficial
in a generic transaction demarcation environment. It allows you to demarcate
transactions on all methods that could potentially perform data access,
without paying a performance penalty if no actual data access happens.
items.translation: 物理 JDBC 连接的惰性获取在通用事务界定环境中特别有益。它允许您在所有可能执行数据访问的方法上界定事务，而无需为未实际发生的数据访问支付性能代价。

items.source:
This DataSource proxy gives you behavior analogous to JTA and a
transactional JNDI DataSource (as provided by the Jakarta EE server), even
with a local transaction strategy like DataSourceTransactionManager or
HibernateTransactionManager. It does not add value with Spring's
JtaTransactionManager as transaction strategy.
items.translation: 此 DataSource 代理提供了与 JTA 以及由 Jakarta EE 服务器提供的事务性 JNDI DataSource 类似的行为，即使在使用 DataSourceTransactionManager 或 HibernateTransactionManager 等本地事务策略时也是如此。如果将 Spring 的 JtaTransactionManager 用作事务策略，则它不会增加任何价值。

items.source:
Lazy fetching of JDBC Connections is also recommended for read-only
operations with Hibernate, in particular if the chances of resolving the
result in the second-level cache are high. This avoids the need to
communicate with the database at all for such read-only operations.
You will get the same effect with non-transactional reads, but lazy fetching
of JDBC Connections allows you to still perform reads in transactions.
items.translation: 对于 Hibernate 的只读操作，也建议使用懒加载 JDBC 连接，特别是当结果在二级缓存中解析的可能性较高时。这样可以完全避免为这些只读操作与数据库通信。非事务性读取也能达到相同效果，但使用 JDBC 连接的懒加载允许您仍在事务中执行读取操作。

items.source:
As of 6.2.6, this DataSource proxy also suppresses a rollback attempt
in case of a timeout where the connection has been closed in the meantime.
items.translation: 自 6.2.6 版本起，此 DataSource 代理还会在连接在此期间已关闭的情况下，抑制因超时而触发的回滚尝试。

items.source: Set the default transaction isolation level by the name of the corresponding constant in Connection — for example, "TRANSACTION_SERIALIZABLE".
items.translation: 通过设置与 Connection 中相应常量的名称来指定默认事务隔离级别——例如，"TRANSACTION_SERIALIZABLE"。

items.source:
Determine default auto-commit and transaction isolation
via a Connection from the target DataSource, if possible.
items.translation: 通过目标 DataSource 的 Connection 确定默认自动提交和事务隔离级别，如果可能的话。

items.source:
Check the default connection properties (auto-commit, transaction isolation),
keeping them to be able to expose them correctly without fetching an actual
JDBC Connection from the target DataSource later on.
items.translation: 检查默认连接属性（自动提交、事务隔离级别），保留这些属性以便稍后在不从目标数据源获取实际 JDBC 连接的情况下正确暴露它们。

items.source: Expose the default auto-commit value.
items.translation: 暴露默认自动提交值。

items.source: Expose the default transaction isolation value.
items.translation: 暴露默认事务隔离级别值。

items.translation: 返回一个连接句柄，该句柄在需要获取 Statement（或 PreparedStatement 或 CallableStatement）时，才会懒式地获取实际的 JDBC 连接。
